methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $5M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Chips & Semiconductors (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 12 same-sector peers exist in Chips & Semiconductors, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

methods.name: Public-Comp Anchoring
methods.skip_reason: target revenue not on file (private companies rarely disclose)
methods.rationale: Public Semiconductors P/S median is 21.0x across 3 tickers. Cannot apply without target's revenue.

data.narrative:
Gallox Semiconductors is a Seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Jon McCandless and Debdeep Jena that has raised $5M+. The Chips & Semiconductors sector comprises 12 same-sector private peers (including Cerebras, Credo Semiconductor, and SambaNova Systems) and 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD).

Due to data constraints, only one valuation method yielded a reliable result. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $5M raised proxy, producing an implied valuation of $12M. Peer-median analysis was inapplicable: while 12 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 met narrow filters on stage, adjacency, or valuation tier. Public-comp anchoring also could not be executed; the three public semiconductors trade at a median 21.0x P/S, but Gallox's revenue—standard practice for private companies—is not on file.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $11M to $14M, with a median of $12M. This single-method result carries material uncertainty. The range reflects only stage-typical step-up mechanics and does not incorporate peer-relative positioning or public market anchoring. Key unknowns include: revenue traction and burn rate, which would enable peer matching and public-comp application; technical differentiation versus the identified peer set; and customer pipeline maturity. Validation of this range requires either disclosure of operating metrics or identification of narrower seed-stage semiconductor comparables with recent funding data.
